description: Config form spec for one cpu Sensor entry in devicecfg.json Sensors[]. contents[] enumerates the editable surface; the frontend renders each Property as one form control (displayName -> label, description -> help text, schema -> input type, writable -> editable vs read-only).
comment: Flattened to one Property per devicecfg.json leaf (paths in each Property's description). IsReadable / IsWritable are intentionally NOT exposed as Properties -- the SIL2 read-only invariant (IsReadable=true, IsWritable=false for every Sensor) is enforced by config-rules.js. Native DTDL covers type + Enum + writable; range, uniqueness, mutex, conditional-required, and Schema/MetricName cross-consistency live in dtdl-validate/scripts/config-rules.js (and its .NET mirror).

schemas.description: Allowed values of Parameters.MetricName when MetricType='cpu'.
SensorGroup allow-list for cpu sensors. Conventionally 'SYS'.
Wire schema allow-list. context_switches -> 'long'; every other CPU MetricName -> 'double'. The MetricName->Schema mapping is enforced by config-rules.js.

contents.name: Name
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: non-empty ASCII string, 1..128 chars, unique within Sensors[]. Uniqueness enforced by config-rules.js.
Maps to: Sensors[i].Name
UI hint: text input on create; read-only after.
Writable: immutable after creation.

contents.name: SensorGroup
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: MUST be a value from the SensorGroup enum (cpu sensors use 'SYS').
Maps to: Sensors[i].SensorGroup
UI hint: dropdown, default 'SYS'.
Writable: immutable after creation.

contents.name: MetricType
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: MUST equal 'cpu' for this Interface.
Maps to: Sensors[i].Parameters.MetricType
UI hint: fixed label, not editable.
Writable: immutable -- changing it requires defining a new Sensor.

contents.name: MetricName
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: MUST be a value from CpuMetricName.
Maps to: Sensors[i].Parameters.MetricName
UI hint: dropdown.
Writable: immutable after creation.

contents.name: Enabled
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: boolean.
Maps to: Sensors[i].Report.Enabled
UI hint: toggle / switch.
Writable: twin desired-property sync-able (SIL2 maintenance lever).

contents.name: Interval
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: integer, 1 <= v <= 300000 (5 minutes). Range enforced by config-rules.js.
Maps to: Sensors[i].Report.Interval
UI hint: number input, min=1, max=300000, step=100, default=5000.
Writable: twin desired-property sync-able.

contents.name: Description
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: non-empty string.
Maps to: Sensors[i].SensorInfo.Description
UI hint: textarea or text input.
Writable: twin desired-property sync-able.

contents.name: DisplayName
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: non-empty string.
Maps to: Sensors[i].SensorInfo.DisplayName
UI hint: short text input.
Writable: twin desired-property sync-able.

contents.name: Schema
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: MUST equal 'long' when MetricName='context_switches'; MUST equal 'double' for every other CpuMetricName. Cross-field rule enforced by config-rules.js; the agent rejects startup on mismatch.
Maps to: Sensors[i].SensorInfo.Schema
UI hint: dropdown auto-selected by MetricName.
Writable: immutable after creation.

comment: Interface and Interfaces are mutually exclusive when both non-empty (config-rules.js rules.network). Interfaces='' / [] means auto-detect. Every network MetricName -> wire schema 'long'.

Maps to: Sensors[i].Parameters.Interfaces
UI hint: chip / tag input. Empty = auto-detect.
Writable: immutable after creation.
